headline: Chutes (Bittensor SN64): 1 validator hotkey SS58 address and partial subnet-owner keys surfaced; no EVM contracts exist; DeFiPunkd on-chain API unsupported for Substrate chains.
short_headline: 1 validator SS58 key; no EVM contracts

findings.text: D1: Bittensor is a Substrate chain — not indexed by any EVM block explorer in the supported set (etherscan.io, basescan.org, arbiscan.io, etc.). No EVM name-tag search is possible. tao.app and bittensor.ai/subnets/64 surfaced partial owner coldkey (5FRYKh...AyS9) and owner hotkey (5F4Q3c...qULc) for subnet 64, but these are truncated SS58 addresses that cannot be used as EVM addresses. Validator hotkey 5Dt7HZ7Zpw4DppPxFM7Ke3Cm7sDAWhsZXmM5ZAmE7dSVJbcQ surfaced in full from miner docs and chutes-api README.

D2: Official docs at docs.chutes.ai and chutes.ai/docs confirmed; no deployed-contracts page exists because Chutes is not an EVM protocol — it is Bittensor Subnet 64, a Substrate-based network. The docs describe API endpoints (api.chutes.ai, llm.chutes.ai) and hotkey-based authentication, not EVM contract addresses. No deployed_contracts_doc URL found.
D3: protocol.audit_links = none recorded; no audit PDFs were found in GitHub repos or docs. No scope address tables to extract.

D4: GitHub org github.com/chutesai contains repos: chutes (SDK/CLI), chutes-miner, chutes-api, fiber, e2ee-proxy, claude-proxy, chutes-audit, sek8s, and ~51 total repos. No Foundry broadcast JSON, hardhat-deploy artifacts, or deployment address manifests found — confirmed by repo file tree showing only chutes/, docs/, examples/, logintercept/, tests/ directories. Additional older org reference github.com/rayonlabs/chutes and github.com/rayonlabs/chutes-miner surfaced in docs and third-party sources. No EVM deployment artifacts found in any repo.

D5: protocol.chains = [Bittensor] only. Bittensor is a single Substrate chain (netuid 64 identifies the subnet). No multi-chain EVM deployments exist to enumerate. Zero EVM addresses surfaced across all sources tried.

D6: No factory contracts exist in EVM sense. Bittensor subnet registration is the on-chain primitive; validators and miners register via btcli on the Bittensor chain. DeFiPunkd read API does not support Bittensor/Substrate chainId — no factory enumeration possible.

D7: Role taxonomy applied to discovered Substrate SS58 addresses: validator hotkey (5Dt7HZ7Zpw4DppPxFM7Ke3Cm7sDAWhsZXmM5ZAmE7dSVJbcQ) classified as 'other' with actor_class='unknown' (Bittensor hotkey, not EVM EOA/multisig). Subnet owner coldkey and hotkey are partially truncated and cannot be reliably recorded as admin_addresses. Chutes Global Corp is the registered legal entity (IBC in Nevis, registration C 61974).

D8: Only one address surfaced in full from fetched URLs: validator hotkey SS58 5Dt7HZ7Zpw4DppPxFM7Ke3Cm7sDAWhsZXmM5ZAmE7dSVJbcQ, found verbatim in both the miner-resources docs page and chutes-api GitHub README. Subnet owner keys are snippet-only (truncated) from tao.app and bittensor.ai — placed in unknowns[], not admin_addresses[].

rationale.verdict: Discovery blocked from producing a grade because Chutes is a Bittensor/Substrate protocol with no EVM smart contracts. The DeFiPunkd on-chain API supports only EVM chainIds (1, 10, 56, 130, 137, 324, 8453, 42161, 43114, 59144, 81457, 534352, 11155111); Bittensor is not in scope. One validator hotkey SS58 address was surfaced from fetched sources; subnet owner keys are partially truncated in search snippets. All corpora walked: chutes.ai website, docs.chutes.ai, github.com/chutesai (51 repos), search results from tao.app, bittensor.ai, CoinGecko, CoinMarketCap, chutes-api README. Total: 1 full SS58 address catalogued, 0 EVM addresses.

protocol_metadata.about: Chutes is a decentralized, serverless AI compute platform operating as Subnet 64 on the Bittensor network, developed by Rayon Labs (operating as Chutes Global Corp). Users deploy and scale open-source AI models — LLMs, diffusion, embedding, speech, and video — by defining containerized FastAPI applications as Python code, which are then executed on GPU hardware contributed by miners. The platform handles scaling, billing (pay-per-GPU-hour), and routing of inference requests via Bittensor hotkey-signed authentication and GraVal GPU attestation middleware, with miner rewards distributed through Bittensor's on-chain incentive mechanism.
